items.prompt: Hex digit A equals which decimal value?
items.explain: Hex digits after 9 are A=10, B=11, …, F=15. So A₁₆ = 10₁₀. Option 16 is the base (radix), not the digit value.

items.prompt: How many distinct values can 5 bits represent?
Writing 5 as 0b101 or 0x5 does not change the value.
Converting one hex digit uses a group of how many bits?
items.explain: 16 = 2^4, so one hex digit is 4 bits.
